title: the restore drill runs in a throwaway database server (option d)
note: lane H's card H-84 (high-risk); the integrator's option (d), 2026-11-22

findings.claim: on master the restore drill runs CREATE DATABASE as trialbox, which the box makes NOCREATEDB: the drill cannot run on an installed box
on master the restore drill connects to db:5432 from the host, a name the host cannot resolve and a port compose does not publish: the drill cannot run on an installed box
the restore drill is typed with the host's python3, which install.sh gives only python3-yaml, while backup.py imports zstandard and cryptography and the drill needs psycopg
sudo drops the operator's environment, so TB_DB_URL (read by the drill for the database names) is unset and the drill refuses at once
a restore drill killed during its restore left the decrypted backup in the work folder with no record, and nothing removed it
